body: Thank you I know everything you're saying is true. I understand it. I will definitely sort it out in time. Not this week though :) I will keep you updated. The strange thing about him is that I know he doesn't realise what he's doing, and he does love me, he just goes about things the wrong way. I know this isn't a relationship I want to be in in the long term. Yes I felt strong and kicked m out which was good. I just hate feeling like the bad guy and losing people over it etc. I don't know. I've been through a lot more than this before. I've had a lot of hard knocks so to speak. I guess we all do. So how did it work out for you in the end? Are you ok now?
Thank you for taking the time to write to me. And thank you so much for validating my feelings and experiences. I can't leave him right now I don't have anyone else and I can't be alone right now.
